name: Boku wa Bitch no Ero Ikenie
original_name: 僕はビッチのエロ生贄
source:
The protagonist is transferring to a new school in the city due to his parents' works. Little does he know, that school is where many famous sluts go to. And so, during class, in the middle of a break, after school... anytime, anywhere, his life full of erotic moments begins.
